City of Inglewood
  Finance Department
  (310) 412-5257

  AGENDA
  CLAIMS REVIEW COMMITTEE
  October 12, 2020

11:30 a.m. – Finance Executive Conference, 1th Floor

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
Persons wishing to address the Inglewood Claims Review Committee on any item on the agenda may do
so at this time.

  1. Approve the minutes of the September 28, 2020, meeting.

  2. Thomas Dale & Associates – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for
  investigation services.

  3. Johnson Controls - Executive session to discuss recommend payment for the monitoring
  and service calls for the fire alarm system at the Senior Center.

Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
Persons wishing to address the Claims Review Committee on any matter connected with City business not
elsewhere considered on the agenda may do so at this time.

  Adjournment.

  Distribution
  Campos, K
  Heaney, M.
